meta.title: 3 Days in Hoi An Vietnam 🇻🇳 Best Food, Cafes, Shopping & Boutique Hotel | Vietnam Travel Guide 2026
meta.description:
Planning 3 days in Hoi An, Vietnam? 🇻🇳 In this travel vlog, we explore all the best things to do, see and eat in this stunning city. 

One of South East Asia's oldest and most beautiful ancient towns, Hoi An is filled with lantern lit streets, preserved shophouses and a bustling, scenic riverside.

After checking in to our luxury boutique hotel, we discover the best food and cafes in Hoi An. From must-try Michelin Guide restaurants to local specialties and even a farm to table restaurant and hidden cafe in the middle of a vegetable island.

And, since visitors travel from all over the world  to have clothes, bags, shoes and even jewelry custom made in Hoi An, we do our share of shopping, too.

This Vietnam Travel guide covers everything you need to know, from where to eat, what to do, and where to stay for the perfect trip to Hoi An.

#hoianvietnam  #vietnamtravel #hoiantravelguide

comments.text: Yes, the image in English means ''Born to drift free” Similar to other familiar names the top-of-the-line electric motorcycle is the Vinfast Viper and when associated with Da Nang city and Hoi An ancient town creates a poetic parallel image. It reflects both the free-spiritedness of a young, modern city and the tranquil rhythm of an ancient heritage site. - Modern Da Nang: A city of bridges, beaches, and a dynamic pace of life, always looking towards the future. - Ancient Hoi An: An ancient town with lanterns, moss-covered tiled roofs, where memories and culture are preserved. - The spirit of freedom: On one side, a constantly moving flow; on the other, a stillness that remains open to the world. This combination makes the phrase “Born to drift free” a powerful and evocative message: both an invitation to tourists and an affirmation of the identity of this Central Vietnamese region I LOVE VIETNAM FORM DA NANG CITY AND HOI AN ANCIENT.
